newsitem.title: FRANCE: Juppe to present French election platform Tuesday.
newsitem.headline: Juppe to present French election platform Tuesday.

text.p: French Prime Minister Alain Juppe will present his centre-right coalition's election platform in a keynote policy speech on Tuesday, Foreign Minister Herve de Charette said on Monday.

He was speaking to reporters after talks with Juppe hours before President Jacques Chirac was expected to announce the dissolution of the National Assembly and call a snap general election nine months ahead of schedule.
"Of course I will be at the prime minister's side tomorrow," de Charette said.
Political sources said Juppe would deliver the address at 3.30 p.m. (1330 GMT) at the Palais des Congres conference centre in Paris after lunching with coalition leaders.
De Charette said he was not afraid that an election campaign dominated by debate over a single European currency would exacerbate anti-European sentiment.
"I have no fear about Europe," he said.
